name: Ownly Capture
_versioning: Extension version ships independently from Web/PWA (package.json / src/core/runtime.ts WYQD_CORE_TARGET_VERSION). Extension follows Chrome Web Store review cadence; app releases follow docs/VERSIONING.md. Do not force the two versions to match.
description: Capture travel research from Google Maps, Booking.com, Tabelog and Xiaohongshu into Ownly Planner, with selection FX conversion.
_iconNotes: Icons are wired from public/icons (ownly-mark.svg, ownly-192.svg, ownly-512.svg) and copied by scripts/build-extension.mjs into dist/extension/icons. Chrome Web Store requires 16/48/128 + action.default_icon.

_permissionNotes.sidePanel: Required to open the Ownly Capture side panel via the action button.
_permissionNotes.storage: Persists ownlyCaptureStateV3 inbox queue and ownlyCaptureLang in chrome.storage.local; only the MV3 background worker writes the queue.
_permissionNotes.scripting: Injects content scripts on supported travel/mapping hosts for place extraction and list sync.
_permissionNotes.activeTab: Reads the active tab URL/title once when the user captures or re-detects currency.
_permissionNotes.tabs: Finds an open Google Maps tab for enrichment context and reuses an open Ownly planner tab for capture-sync handoff.

_hostPermissionNotes.google_maps_domains: Page adapters read place facts and saved lists only on Google Maps/Travel paths.
_hostPermissionNotes.booking_agoda_tabelog_xiaohongshu: Provider adapters extract the user's own research facts on those hosts only.
_hostPermissionNotes.open_er_api: open.er-api.com serves reference FX pivot rates for display-only conversion; raw captured price text is never rewritten.

quick-capture-place.description: Quickly capture current place to active trip

_contentScriptNotes.fx_tooltip_all_hosts: fx-tooltip.js intentionally matches http/https everywhere because selection FX must work on any merchant page where the user selects price text. It is toggle-gated in the side panel, runs display-only conversion locally, and never exfiltrates page content. Narrowing to optional_host_permissions would break one-click merchant coverage; review as display-only UX.
_contentScriptNotes.ownly_bridge_origins: ownly-bridge.js runs only on first-party Ownly origins: liuh886.github.io/ownly (hosted Web/PWA), zhihaol.eu.org (custom domain), localhost/127.0.0.1 (local dev). It validates same-window same-origin postMessage and delegates mutations to the background worker.
